title: Purpose-dependent drought accumulation scales in rainfed Turkish Thrace: code and derived data
description:
Analysis code and derived, analysis-ready data accompanying the article “Purpose-dependent drought accumulation scales for canopy monitoring and yield prediction in rainfed Turkish Thrace: a cropland Landsat Vegetation Health Index evaluation” (C. Kıvrak and M. Şener, International Journal of Climatology).

A cropland-masked 30 m Landsat Vegetation Health Index (CORINE class 211, α = 0.5) is evaluated against SPI and SPEI at 1-, 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month accumulation scales across seven districts of Turkish Thrace for 1985–2024. Ten candidate indices are scored on four non-duplicated criteria over one identical complete-case sample (n = 1,183), with selection uncertainty from a two-way block bootstrap, leave-one-year-out categorical skill, a district fixed-effects yield panel, and a multi-resolution aggregation test.

Running python code/verify_headline_numbers.py reproduces the headline results of the paper from the files in data/: SPEI-3 composite 40/40 with r = 0.520, SPI-3 34, SPEI-9 32, bootstrap selection frequency 63.7 %, and Heidke skill score 0.297.

Licensing: the code in code/ is released under the MIT licence; the derived data in data/ are released under CC BY 4.0. The underlying raw records from the Turkish State Meteorological Service (MGM) and the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) are not redistributed and remain subject to those agencies' terms — see LICENSE-DATA.md.
